recordings.title: Real GPU: mixed prefill and decode
recordings.summary: Recorded on an NVIDIA A100 with vLLM 0.30.0 and Qwen3-4B. Explore actual request tokens, full KV inventory, packed batch membership and measured layer activity. This historical recording predates per-layer cache-write scopes and numerical K/V snapshots.

recordings.title: Real GPU: partial prefix reuse
recordings.summary: A real vLLM 0.30.0 run shows a matching cached prompt prefix, the remaining prefill work and subsequent decoding. Inspect original content and current holders. This historical recording contains step-boundary KV observations, without numerical tensor snapshots.

recordings.title: Model and KV walkthrough
recordings.summary: Six staggered synthetic requests with authored readable word fragments explore a full eight-block KV pool and pinned public Qwen3 architecture geometry. This teaching fixture loads no model weights and contains no GPU timing measurements.

recordings.title: Continuous batching
recordings.summary: Request B is admitted after A has accepted an output token. A later step lists both request ids. This file was produced by the fixture engine.

recordings.title: Single request
recordings.summary: One request keeps a single scheduled cursor, accepted token ids, emitted text, and a terminal status.

recordings.title: Chunked prefill
recordings.summary: The long prompt is scheduled as two ranges. The second step also gives the short request a generation token.

recordings.title: Prefix reuse
recordings.summary: The second request matches four prefix tokens, so this step starts at token 4. Matching a prefix skips that prompt work. It does not skip ordinary decoding.

recordings.title: Prefix miss
recordings.summary: A changed prefix matches zero tokens, so the full prompt range is scheduled.

recordings.title: Preemption and recomputation
recordings.summary: The scheduled cursor returns to 0 and the same block id comes back as a new allocation generation. The trace records the transition. It does not record a decision reason.

recordings.title: Cancellation
recordings.summary: One request completes. The other is cancelled. Those are different terminal events.

recordings.title: Incomplete capture
recordings.summary: The collector filled its buffer, wrote one trace gap, and kept the events already queued. State after the gap is unknown.
